project.readme:
# MyScoutee Template

Template backend and frontend delivery, using the portfolio’s standard task, status, effort and usage fields.

[Backend and releases](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template) · [Frontend](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template-frontend) · [Live demo](https://fssrepository.github.io/myscoutee-template-frontend/) · [Roadmap](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap)

**MSC-122: Done — 1.4.0 published and verified on VMware.**

The MSC-122 issue is shared with MyScoutee. Its 1,304,324,997 tokens / 46.804358 allocated h / partial API valuation are already counted in the MyScoutee total; this Project is another view of the same work, not additional usage. The snapshot and measurement references are saved in the roadmap repository.

October 17 regression: **1–32 PASS / CLOSED**, including point 31 call/notification deltas and fixture/runtime cleanup. Usage includes the original delivery and 170,212,864 regression tokens through 2026-10-17T07:51:53.465Z. Full API cost unavailable; $1,576.71 frozen known-rate subtotal only. [Evidence](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template/blob/master/guides/qa/evidence/general/MSC115-TEMPLATE-REGRESSION.json). New DEB build/installation not claimed.

items.title: MSC-122: Extract reusable UI components and a generic MyScoutee template
items.body:
Delivered **MyScoutee Template 1.4.0** and **MyScoutee Components 1.4.0** on October 12, 2026.

- [x] Separate reusable components and generic application foundations from product-specific domains.
- [x] Keep MyScoutee consuming the same component owners and preserve its qualified behavior.
- [x] Qualify local/HTTP login, consent, profiles, SmartList, chat and retained operator/admin capabilities.
- [x] Qualify monolith/KVM, packaging, signed updates, recovery and publication.
- [x] Install the exact published template DEB on VMware and complete the two-member login/SmartList/chat/logout smoke.
- [x] Publish branded PDF manuals, GitHub Pages and the components npm package.

[Template and documentation](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template) · [Live demo](https://fssrepository.github.io/myscoutee-template-frontend/) · [Template 1.4.0](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template/releases/tag/v1.4.0) · [Components 1.4.0](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-components/releases/tag/v1.4.0)

**Checklist: 33/33 tasks and 118/118 subtasks DONE.** Git history, roadmap/account usage and heatmap are updated. The [Template Project](https://github.com/users/fssrepository/projects/6) connects both template repositories. The LinkedIn article, short sharing post and branded cover are committed in the private backend guides. General MyScoutee feature-QA campaigns remain separate.

## Template regression closeout — 2026-10-17

Template regression 1–32 PASS / CLOSED, including point 31 call/notification deltas and point 32 fixture/runtime cleanup. Accepted evidence retained; omitted consumers N/A. New DEB build/installation not claimed.

The HTTP operator OAuth/login return now uses the existing common entry completion flow. Normal media/job configuration persists in canonical seeds and upgrade migration; test actors/faults were removed. Browser evidence, focused native checks and local/HTTP/KVM variants apply only to the scopes recorded in the existing [regression evidence](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template/blob/master/guides/qa/evidence/general/MSC115-TEMPLATE-REGRESSION.json). The checklist was retained. Owned browser sessions and test processes are closed; original support services restored.

MSC-122 measured usage: **1,304,324,997 tokens**, **46.917611 active / 46.804358 allocated hours**, through **2026-10-17T07:51:53.465Z**. Original October 12 delivery: 1,134,112,133; regression increment: 170,212,864. Corrections, reverted attempts and failure/recovery are included. Full API equivalent is unavailable; $1,576.71 is a frozen known-rate subtotal only. Both Projects show the same shared task; usage is counted once. [Measurement components and reproduction](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/tree/master/guides/project-history/myscoutee). Final accounting/publication after cutoff is excluded.
